build.output:
'Delphi.Perturb.thermal_rules_out' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'Delphi.Perturb.perturb_nonvacuous' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

witness.name: Delphi.Perturb.perturb_nonvacuous
witness.via: bundle Record has a field of type ThermalPerformance, a hypothesis of Delphi.Perturb.thermal_rules_out

joint.outcome: theorem from standard axioms with no shared-scope hypotheses: consistent with every satisfiable law set

law.statement_en: Under the thermal-performance hypothesis (sustained power zero outside [CTmin, CTmax], and at most P_ref Q10^((T - T_ref)/10) inside), no positive sustained power is possible outside the thermal window, and sustained power never exceeds the Q10 bound.

hypotheses.name: see theorem statement
hypotheses.statement: the named hypothesis structure(s) in the theorem statement; instantiated with fetched numbers in Delphi.Perturb.measured

scope.basis: thermal performance curves of ectotherms (Schulte 2015); Q10 values from teleost red muscle (scup, carp; Rome 1992). CTmin, CTmax, Q10 and P_ref are design inputs.

sources: Schulte PM 2015, The effects of temperature on aerobic metabolism: towards a mechanistic understanding of the responses of ectotherms to a changing environment (PMID 26085663, doi:10.1242/jeb.118851); lean/perturb-sources.json#schulte2015
